deterministic_compare: MATCH: eight deterministic scientific summaries, all supplied cases, and all CSV result columns except timing.
interpretation: Local standalone self-reproduction, not independent third-party reproduction.

resource_observation.measurement_scope: process_time and RUSAGE_SELF describe only the main experiment worker. Completed serial child CPU is added from RUSAGE_CHILDREN. Child RSS is not reported or summed; the main-process peak is not a process-tree peak.

reference_environment.resource_module_assumption: POSIX resource semantics; Windows requires adaptation.

resource_limits.scope: POSIX per-process limits on the worker, inherited by spawned CLI children; the CPU limit is not an aggregate process-tree limit.

scope: Clean standalone artifact tree before archive creation; no manuscript, network, third-party Python package, solver, GPU, or model API was required.
